messages.content: I’ll submit a day-ahead position for the first day, keeping room to adjust dispatch as the weather and real-time outlook change. I’ll limit reserve awards during high-PV hours to avoid curtailment, then manage the book through every watch to final settlement.

The first two days have settled to $99,637 net so far, with no charged failures to provide. All three DAM submissions are in. For the final day, I’m refining the morning charging plan and allowing for uncertain regulation charging before the terminal SoC requirement.
